Hi Rishi —

Goldleaf's security team is compiling our SIG/CAIQ submission and we need a compact evidence packet related to Redwood's business continuity and recovery posture. Please provide the items below by Dec 10:

- RTO/RPO test summary (most recent live failover + tabletop results)

- Chain-of-custody note for encryption keys used in recovery (where applicable)

We may request a short remote witness session; please indicate availability windows during Dec 13–17.
